newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas untraded, offered down in soft market.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas untraded, offered down in soft market.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures were again untraded on Tuesday morning after a blank day on Monday when no deals were done.
But the continued weakness in the market was shown by the offer prices in the first three months, all of which were below the settlement level on Monday.
Front month August was bid at 9.00 pence a therm by the 1100 GMT close of the morning session, and offered at 9.35 pence. This compares with the settlement level of 9.45 pence on Monday.
And September and October were offered at 9.50 pence and 10.70 pence respectively, against previous settlement levels of 9.54 pence and 10.825 pence.

Further out, bids and offers straddled the last settlement price, and were often far apart. March 1998 saw a full penny a therm between the two, with a bid at 13.50 pence facing an offer of 14.50 pence.
